We made an app for food. The app takes a photo. It finds the food in the photo. Then it shows the calories. We used Python for the code. We used a model called YOLO. YOLO can find many things in one photo. This is good for Indian food. Indian plates have many dishes. We took 700 photos. We took them in the canteen. We also took some at home. We marked each dish in each photo. This took two weeks. Then we trained the model. Training took six hours. We used a laptop for training. The laptop was slow. The first results were bad. The model mixed up dal and sambar. They look the same. We added more photos of both. Then the results got better. The final accuracy was 71 percent. The calories are not exact. We use average portion sizes. Big portions get too few calories. Small portions get too many. We want to fix this later. We want to use the plate size. Our guide liked the project. We learned a lot about data. Data was the hardest part.
